phases.objective: Replace manual reconstruction of Frontend surface dispatch failures with exact-candidate structured reports, produce and apply a bounded exact-operation OpenAPI auth repair through the registered generated-artifact maintenance tool without widening document defaults, keep pull-request verification read-only for repository contents, and delegate mutation through the reviewed exact-head push dispatcher merged on main at 4c5a8a97cff4ce418860d5e91e2234587045ba2b.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Read-only Frontend surface dispatch and PR Generated Artifact Refresh, with the generated-artifact-refresh label permitting the reviewed push dispatcher to delegate a governed exact-head refresh
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Pull-request workflows publish bounded JSON and Markdown identifying the first failed verification stage, while the registered exact-head maintenance tool applies only reviewed canonical and generated files and emits a canonical mutation report.
steps: Checkout the exact pull-request candidate without persisted credentials for validation.
Fetch the canonical default branch and force the local canonical ref to the fetched origin ref.
Validate that auth sync inserts operation-level security while preserving unrelated document-level defaults.
Generate bounded canonical OpenAPI auth repairs in the ephemeral runner workspace.
Generate frontend dispatch, operation-governance, and runtime OpenAPI evidence against that exact canonical ref.
Reject changes outside openapi.yaml, openapi/support-tickets.yaml, and the governed generated evidence set.
Validate the structured verification, dispatcher, and maintenance-tool evidence reporters.
Run each frontend verification command as a named ordered evidence stage.
Check committed generated-output parity as a named evidence stage.
Stop at the first failure and retain bounded redacted diagnostics.
Upload structured reports and bounded repair files before enforcing decisions.
Keep pull-request jobs at contents: read with no direct repository push capability.
Require the generated-artifact-refresh label, same-repository head, non-bot actor, governed target branch, and exact head SHA before dispatch.
Dispatch governed-generated-artifact-refresh.yml on main with target_ref, expected_head_sha, and APPLY_GENERATED_ARTIFACT_REFRESH.
Re-check local and remote exact-head identity immediately before the registered mutator commits and pushes.
Commit only registered canonical and generated files by non-force push.
Publish mad4b.governed-generated-artifact-refresh.v1 as the mutation evidence source.
assertions: Pull-request evidence records merge-candidate SHA separately from source-head SHA.
Validation and governed refresh both move local main to origin/main after fetching.
Canonical auth repair inserts exact operation-level security and never widens a mixed document root security default.
Unrelated inherited public operations remain unchanged.
Verification and dispatch reports name the first failed stage or code with bounded diagnostics.
Diagnostics redact authorization values, OAuth tokens, secrets, API keys, passwords, cookies, GitHub tokens, and JWT-shaped values.
Job logs are diagnostic-only and are not required when structured diagnostics exist.
Pull-request jobs keep contents read-only and never perform a direct git push.
The dispatcher receives only actions: write plus read permissions needed to delegate the registered workflow.
The dispatcher rejects main, Production, malformed branches, and non-exact SHAs before API dispatch.
The dispatched mutator remains workflow_dispatch-only and requires exact-head typed confirmation.
The maintenance tool refuses stale local heads and stale remote heads.
The registered repair write set includes only reviewed canonical OpenAPI and generated contract files.

phases.objective: Route verification, dispatch, and mutation reports through the trusted canonical PR evidence publisher after all workflow definitions are present on the default branch.

Exercise dispatch authorization rejection, process spawn faults, missing reports, oversized diagnostics, stale candidates, concurrent refresh pushes, mixed-profile canonical documents, write-set violations, and artifact upload failures.
Observe the first non-production exact-head dispatch and verify reviewers no longer require manual Job-log reading.
Require canonical structured frontend verification evidence for protected release promotion while keeping protected branches outside refresh mutation scope.
